loading.title: Loading quiz
loading.body: Please wait while the questions are prepared.

error.title: Quiz link cannot be used
error.body: The quiz token is invalid, expired, or the test has already been submitted. Please contact HR for assistance.

submitted.title: Answers submitted
submitted.body: Thank you. The HR team will continue the process based on system validation.

timeout.title: Time is up
timeout.body: Answers already filled in have been submitted automatically.

confirm.title: Some questions are unanswered
confirm.body: You can still submit now, but blank questions will be counted as unanswered.
